items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: He was in my band, the band that I organized in Omaha, Nebraska.

ctx.x: I'd let him play a solo, but I let him play it early in the arrangement. Then I'd even have him lay out, you know, a few bars just before the last chorus, and when we'd come out there, he'd pick the arrangement right up -- wouldn't miss a note, and he (inaudible). And he (inaudible), you know, you could see that he was dependable. And this is why I always liked him. And could play any part, first, second or third, he wasn't limited. We made a recording of "Chloe" that, one side John Kirby and his group made…

He was in my band, the band that I organized in Omaha, Nebraska. Israel Crosby were the only two Emmett Berry and (inaudible) fellows that I took there and built filled the rest of the band around these two guys.
I see. Yeah. I remember. We talked about that. In fact, the next person on the list is Israel Crosby.
